about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. JS is measured with Vite's 8-character chunk hashes replaced by a fixed string, so renaming a chunk does not move the totals. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Reset 2026-11-06 at 5e78c96 plus #211 to the hash-stable measure plus 25 B (entry 33145, boot 1166495, workers 2565597, lazy 3048380); workers and lazy dropped by the shared POI data chunk (#211). 2026-11-06, #207 (?ktx2=etc1s, measured at its merge with 2465464): boot 1166520 to 1166546 (measured 1166536: the ktx2 flag becomes a text flag and assets.ts gates the lazy import on its two values), workers 2565622 to 2565676 (measured 2565666: the workers bundle client/src/flags.ts, whose ktx2 entry grows), lazy 3048405 to 3048451 (measured 3048441: the etc1s branch in the ktx2-tex chunk). Each is the measure plus 10 B. Then lazy raised from 3048451 to 3048789 (measured 3048779, +338 B over main's 3048441), an exception the Captain approved for a player-facing fix in lazy code: the client re-traces a predicted hit past the server's rewind cap against the pose at the cap so it shows no marker the server will take back (ClientMatch.lateVerdict, #222).
